senses.gloss: (b. h.) pr. n. m. Balaam, the gentile prophet of the Pentateuch.
units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 105a:7">Snh. 105ᵃ</cite> <he>ב׳ בַּלַּע עם</he> Ar. (Var. in Ar., a. ed. <cite ref="B00804"><he>בַּלָּא</he></cite>) devourer (destroyer) of the people; other homilet. etymology ibid. <he>שבִּלָּה עם</he> he ruined the people (through debauchery; Rashi: = <cite ref="B00814"><he>בִּלְבֵּל</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 5:19">Ab. V, 19</cite> (as type of false teachers); a. fr.
